_notes: PF resolution history, seasons 2013-14 through 2026-27. season=2013 means the 2013-14 school year. Every resolution here was verified verbatim on 2026-08-27 against the NSDA's own topics page: seasons 2013-14 through 2025-26 from the 'Past Topics - Public Forum Debate' list on the Wayback-archived NSDA topics page (snapshot 2026-07-20, URL in each row's source_url; cross-checked against a 2025-05-09 snapshot, debatedrills.com/past-topics, and Wikipedia), and 2026-SO from the live page (also spec section 6.1, verified 2026-08-28). No row is unverified; there are no gaps. Cadence history, reflected in the slots: Sep/Oct (SO) has been one combined topic since 2013-14; November (NOV) and December (DEC) were separate monthly topics through 2017-18 and one combined Nov/Dec (ND) topic from 2018-19 on; January (JAN) and February (FEB) are monthly; March (MA) and April (APR) are separate topics in every season covered; NATS is the National Tournament topic, debated at NSDA Nationals in June (window here: June 1-30 of the season's closing year). Windows are calendar-month competition windows; May has no NSDA PF topic window, so May rounds fall through to the keyword fallback or the Unassigned bucket. 2026-27 status as of 2026-08-27: only the Sep/Oct topic is announced; the NSDA lists potential topics for the later slots and announces each winner on its release schedule (Nov/Dec on ~Oct 1), so those rows are intentionally absent until announced. Overrides: the NSDA National Tournament entries map to the season's NATS topic, which is what the NSDA's own lists label those topics ('Nationals <year>'). No TOC override is seeded: TOC is held in late April and its use of the April topic is covered by the date window; a per-year designated-topic override was not verified. NCFL Grand Nationals sets its own topics (per the NSDA page's footnote) and is deliberately not mapped.
